rules.condition: High-impact macro data releases (CPI, FOMC, NFP)
rules.hard_constraint: No new market or limit entries within 5 minutes before/after event
rules.rationale: Slippage spike and erratic spread expansion during high volatility events

rules.hard_constraint: Maximum position sizing capped at 15 contracts per trade
rules.rationale: Prevents overleveraging in thin off-market order books

rules.condition: After a stop-loss or realized loss on rTSLAUSDT
rules.hard_constraint: No re-entry on correlated contracts for 30 minutes
rules.rationale: Stops immediate size-up and revenge trades right after a stop-out
